name: Bigotry
overview: Scripture reveals that bigotry manifests in unjust judgments and exclusion based on superficial or misguided standards. For example, Jesus faced accusations of gluttony and association with sinners despite His wisdom and mission (Matthew 11:18-19; Mark 2:16). His disciples even rebuked those who brought children to Him, showing a lack of understanding and acceptance (Matthew 19:13). These passages underscore the danger of rejecting God's work and people due to prejudice rather than recognizing true holiness and grace.
